name: 添加任务
desc: 多行输入解析标题/描述、空输入与 AI 描述为空时按钮禁用、取消不新增且重开草稿为空、底部统计与侧栏计数同步、刷新后持久化（reload 后用数值等待让页面复活，就绪轮询放在 eval 里）

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.item = (t) => T.items().find((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text')) === t) || null; T.need = (t) => { const i = T.item(t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); const root = document.querySelector('o-page').shadowRoot; if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('清场后不应有任务'); if (!root.querySelector('.empty')) throw new Error('空列表应显示空状态'); T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('「添加任务」未打开弹窗'); const sb = (label) => Array.from(T.dlg().querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === label); if (!sb('添加').hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('空输入时「添加」应禁用'); if (!sb('AI 生成').hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('AI 描述为空时「AI 生成」应禁用'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.ai-field'), '明天下午三点和客户开会'); await T.wait(300); if (sb('AI 生成').hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('输入 AI 描述后「AI 生成」应启用'); return 'ok';

T.dlgBtn('取消'); await T.wait(350); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('点「取消」后弹窗应关闭'); if (T.items().length !== 0) throw new Error('取消不应新增任务'); T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (d.querySelector('.dialog-field').value !== '') throw new Error('重开弹窗草稿应为空'); if (d.querySelector('.ai-field').value !== '') throw new Error('重开弹窗 AI 描述应为空'); T.dlgBtn('取消'); await T.wait(350); return 'ok';

await T.addTask('买牛奶', '两盒' + T.NL + '顺便买鸡蛋'); if (T.items().length !== 1) throw new Error('应新增 1 条任务，实际 ' + T.items().length); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('添加成功后弹窗应关闭'); const i = T.need('买牛奶'); if (T.tx(i.querySelector('.desc')) !== '两盒' + T.NL + '顺便买鸡蛋') throw new Error('描述解析不正确：' + T.tx(i.querySelector('.desc'))); const meta = T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('默认 · 创建于') !== 0) throw new Error('副标题应显示分组与创建时间：' + meta); if (i.className.indexOf('done') !== -1) throw new Error('新任务不应是已完成'); const f = T.tx(T.q('.footer .count')[0]); if (f !== '1 项未完成 · 共 1 项') throw new Error('底部统计不正确：' + f); const g = T.tx(T.q('.gitem .gcount')[0]); if (g !== '1 项') throw new Error('侧栏计数不正确：' + g); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); if (items.length !== 1) throw new Error('刷新后任务丢失，实际 ' + items.length); if (items[0].querySelector('.text').textContent.trim() !== '买牛奶') throw new Error('刷新后标题不正确'); if (items[0].querySelector('.desc').textContent.trim() !== '两盒' + String.fromCharCode(10) + '顺便买鸡蛋') throw new Error('刷新后描述丢失'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
